purpose: Optimize retrieval configuration against downstream answer and task success instead of treating ANN recall as the final objective.
problem: Specialized retrieval infrastructure is difficult to justify when vector search is commoditized unless retrieval policy can be tied to measurable downstream outcomes, freshness, latency, and cost.
intended_outcome: A reviewer or operator can compare retrieval policies on labeled downstream outcomes, reject under-evidenced changes, and select a materially better policy through a reproducible installable tool.
